verified_claims: Coordinatewise scalar torus Fourier coefficients define a square-summable four-spinor coefficient field.
The normalized Fourier-mode synthesis map is surjective onto physical torus four-spinor L2.
There is a complex linear isometric equivalence between physical torus spinor L2 and l2(Z^3; C^4).
The complete coefficient-space continuum and central-difference propagators conjugate to exact physical torus L2 linear isometric equivalences.
Both physical torus propagators preserve norms and inner products and satisfy the time-group law.
For every torus L2 spinor, the central-difference propagator converges strongly to the continuum propagator uniformly on each compact time interval.
nonclaims: No full unbounded continuum Dirac operator or weighted Fourier domain is constructed in this block.
No identification with the functional-calculus exponential of an unbounded self-adjoint Dirac Hamiltonian is claimed.
No strong-resolvent convergence theorem is claimed.
No gauge-covariant or interacting full-space propagator convergence is claimed.
The inherited default-root module packaging conflict is not represented as a passing build.
